ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark) surface area with approximately 5% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution localized to specific markings and edge boundaries.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity mass across both lobes; primary high-contrast feature is an 'X' shaped white marking on the left lobe; secondary high-intensity clusters are located at the lateral distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex angle; depth occupies approximately 20% of the fluke's vertical pixel height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge; peaks and valleys are more pronounced on the right lobe lobe compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upper curvature on both lobes, tapering to acute points at the lateral terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated high-contrast white pixel clusters located at the extreme left and right distal tips, appearing as irregular granular textures.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct intersecting high-intensity linear marks on the mid-left lobe forming an 'X' pattern; several faint, shorter vertical linear marks on the lower right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent intersecting 'X' mark on left ventral surface; irregular serrations and multiple notches along the trailing edge consistent with physical disruption of the boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: The geometric 'X' shaped pigmentation on the left lobe serves as the primary unique spatial identifier.
